title: Batch reduction with step cap
description: A batch of n units is reduced until exactly 1 unit is left. One reduction step works like this: if the current size is divisible by 3, it becomes one third of itself; otherwise it grows by 1. Count the steps needed to get from n to 1 (n = 1 needs 0 steps). The caller allows at most cap steps (cap >= 0). Return Ok with the step count if 1 is reached using at most cap steps. Return Err with the message 'step limit exceeded' if more than cap steps would be needed. If n is less than 1, return Err with the message 'start must be positive' (this is checked before anything else).
notes: Exactly cap steps must still succeed (boundary). n <= 0 is checked first even when cap is generous. Division only on positive values.
